comment: FlareID does not support the 'request' parameter at all and rejects it with request_not_supported, so the module skips rather than passes - unsigned request objects are neither accepted nor exercisable.
id_token_signing_alg_values_supported deliberately omits 'none'; the module skips when unsigned id_tokens are not advertised.
FlareID issues only 'public' subject identifiers; the module skips because pairwise (sector_identifier_uri) is not advertised.
As above - no pairwise subject type, so the bad-sector-identifier registration path cannot be exercised.
